addon.notes:
# New
* Added an All Players list in Organize presets. Per-character presets can still be used as overrides to this list.

### Tagging System
* Added a new tagging system used by Organize to assign groups of items to specific bags through your inventory.
* The tagging system can be accessed through Tools > Tagging and comes with a tag editor and rules settings.
* Comes with some basic tag lists for Omen, Sortie, Ambuscade, & Divergence.

# Bugfixes
* Fixed a bug where Curio's supply count was not properly counting non-inventory bags like Mog Satchel / Sack / Case in resupply checks.
